name: Cuivre River
places: Old Monroe Fire Protection District Station 1
Old Monroe Fire Protection District Station 2
about: Cuivre River drains about 56 square miles, 60% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 630 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 430 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Cuivre River, Whites Branch, Argent Slough and Jordan Branch. St. Charles County communities here include St. Paul, O'Fallon and Josephville. The Cuivre River empties into the Mississippi River.
